arguments.sql_query:
WITH hf_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 316139  -- SNOMED: Heart failure
    UNION SELECT 316139
    UNION SELECT 319835  -- SNOMED: Congestive heart failure
),
hf_hosp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        v.visit_occurrence_id,
        v.person_id,
        CAST(v.visit_start_date AS date) AS admit_date,
        CAST(COALESCE(v.visit_end_date, v.visit_start_date) AS date) AS discharge_date
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = v.person_id
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
    JOIN hf_concepts hf ON hf.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE v.visit_concept_id = 9201
      AND v.visit_start_date >= CAST('2024-08-01' AS date)
      AND v.visit_start_date <  CAST('2026-08-01' AS date)
      AND DATEDIFF(year, CAST(CONCAT(p.year_of_birth, '-01-01') AS date), v.visit_start_date) >= 18
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT
        h.*,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM omop.visit_occurrence r
            WHERE r.person_id = h.person_id
              AND r.visit_concept_id = 9201
              AND r.visit_start_date > h.discharge_date
              AND r.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 30, h.discharge_date)
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmit_30d
    FROM hf_hosp h
)
SELECT
    FORMAT(admit_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS hf_hospitalizations,
    SUM(readmit_30d) AS readmitted_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(readmit_30d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS readmission_rate_pct
FROM indexed
GROUP BY FORMAT(admit_date, 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month;

WITH hf_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 316139
    UNION SELECT 316139
    UNION SELECT 319835
),
hf_hosp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v.visit_occurrence_id, CAST(v.visit_start_date AS date) AS admit_date
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
    JOIN hf_concepts hf ON hf.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = v.person_id
    WHERE v.visit_concept_id = 9201
      AND DATEADD(year, 18, COALESCE(CAST(p.birth_datetime AS date), CAST(CONCAT(p.year_of_birth, '-01-01') AS date))) <= v.visit_start_date
      AND v.visit_start_date >= '2020-01-01'
      AND v.visit_start_date < '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT MIN(admit_date) AS min_hf_hosp_date, MAX(admit_date) AS max_hf_hosp_date, COUNT(*) AS hf_hosp_count
FROM hf_hosp;

WITH hf_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 316139  -- SNOMED: Heart failure
    UNION SELECT 316139
    UNION SELECT 319835  -- SNOMED: Congestive heart failure
),
hf_hosp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        v.visit_occurrence_id,
        v.person_id,
        CAST(v.visit_start_date AS date) AS admit_date,
        CAST(COALESCE(v.visit_end_date, v.visit_start_date) AS date) AS discharge_date
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = v.person_id
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
    JOIN hf_concepts hf ON hf.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE v.visit_concept_id = 9201
      AND v.visit_start_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS date)
      AND v.visit_start_date <  CAST('2026-01-01' AS date)
      AND DATEADD(year, 18, COALESCE(CAST(p.birth_datetime AS date), CAST(CONCAT(p.year_of_birth, '-01-01') AS date))) <= v.visit_start_date
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT
        h.*,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM omop.visit_occurrence r
            WHERE r.person_id = h.person_id
              AND r.visit_concept_id = 9201
              AND r.visit_start_date > h.discharge_date
              AND r.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 30, h.discharge_date)
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmit_30d
    FROM hf_hosp h
)
SELECT
    FORMAT(admit_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS hf_hospitalizations,
    SUM(readmit_30d) AS readmitted_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(readmit_30d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS readmission_rate_pct
FROM indexed
GROUP BY FORMAT(admit_date, 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY month;

content.text:
Using MedCP EHR data, I found adult inpatient visits with a heart-failure diagnosis and calculated 30-day readmission as any subsequent inpatient visit within 30 days of discharge.

**Data availability note:** heart-failure hospitalizations in this dataset run through **2025-12-23**, so the most recent months—especially Nov–Dec 2025—may be incomplete/censored for 30-day readmission follow-up.

| Month | HF hospitalizations | 30-day readmissions | 30-day readmission rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024-01 | 973 | 418 | 42.96% |
| 2024-02 | 1,082 | 475 | 43.90% |
| 2024-03 | 1,102 | 498 | 45.19% |
| 2024-04 | 1,080 | 488 | 45.19% |
| 2024-05 | 1,087 | 451 | 41.49% |
| 2024-06 | 1,116 | 484 | 43.37% |
| 2024-07 | 1,201 | 512 | 42.63% |
| 2024-08 | 1,258 | 526 | 41.81% |
| 2024-09 | 1,183 | 519 | 43.87% |
| 2024-10 | 1,218 | 497 | 40.80% |
| 2024-11 | 1,254 | 615 | 49.04% |
| 2024-12 | 1,364 | 591 | 43.33% |
| 2025-01 | 1,231 | 543 | 44.11% |
| 2025-02 | 928 | 406 | 43.75% |
| 2025-03 | 971 | 415 | 42.74% |
| 2025-04 | 808 | 343 | 42.45% |
| 2025-05 | 758 | 300 | 39.58% |
| 2025-06 | 651 | 292 | 44.85% |
| 2025-07 | 584 | 246 | 42.12% |
| 2025-08 | 431 | 184 | 42.69% |
| 2025-09 | 347 | 121 | 34.87% |
| 2025-10 | 227 | 100 | 44.05% |
| 2025-11 | 123 | 39 | 31.71% |
| 2025-12 | 31 | 6 | 19.35% |

**Trend:** Hospitalizations were roughly stable-to-rising through 2024, peaking at **1,364 in Dec 2024**, then declined sharply during 2025. The 30-day readmission rate was mostly stable in the **~41–45%** range through Aug 2025, with a spike in **Nov 2024 at 49.0%**. The apparent drop in late 2025 should be interpreted cautiously because visit capture and 30-day follow-up appear incomplete.
